column1: # Songs whose title may link their entry (make-entries.js): titles that name nothing else, read by eye (Nov 2026).
# Left out: Imagine, Zombie, Dixie, Katyusha (the rocket launcher), Botany Bay, Scarborough Fair (the fair), John Henry,
# Wind of Change (Macmillan's speech), Bread and Roses (the slogan), Free Nelson Mandela, Jerusalem, La Llorona (the legend) …

# The Sacred War, Red Sun in the Sky, We'll Meet Again (the film), ¡Ay Carmela! (the film), Battōtai (the police unit),
# Three Principles of the People (the ideology), The Bonnie Blue Flag (the flag), Aegukka (South Korea's has the name too)
